actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Distinct customer wishes and workshop discussion suitably illustrate adjustment of services and refurbished-bike inventory. However the lower-left inventory group is visibly three complete bicycles and is labelled Ersatzteile vorrätig halten. Complete bicycles are not spare parts, so that actual image/text binding is technically incorrect.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the customer/repair/refurbishment themes are clear; the lower-left group still visibly contains whole bikes rather than components. Some detailed bullet text is optional, but the mislabeled depiction is not size-dependent.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the exact conflict between complete-bike silhouettes and the spare-parts label is unmistakable. The other demand/adaptation scenes are readable.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The counter laptop and tablet backs face the audience and their users face their screens; the public offer board faces the scene appropriately. The blocker is semantic labeling, not actor perspective.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.
